question_en: An Industrial Electrician is assigned to “Installs electric heating systems and controls”. Under which official RSOS Task is this activity classified?
options: Installs and maintains bonding, grounding and ground-fault protection and detection systems
Installs and maintains electric heating systems and controls
explanation_en: The official Industrial Electrician Task Matrix places C-19.01 under C-19: Installs and maintains electric heating systems and controls.
explanation_es: La matriz oficial de Industrial Electrician ubica C-19.01 dentro de C-19: Installs and maintains electric heating systems and controls.

question_en: A motor starter fails intermittently. What should be obtained before determining the source of the malfunction?
options: A detailed description of the malfunction from facility sources.
A replacement breaker regardless of symptoms.
explanation_en: D-22.02 begins troubleshooting by obtaining and documenting a detailed malfunction description.
explanation_es: D-22.02 inicia el diagnóstico obteniendo y documentando una descripción detallada del mal funcionamiento.

question_en: How should a replacement motor-starter component be selected?
explanation_en: The RSOS requires OEM or equivalent replacement components.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige componentes de reemplazo OEM o equivalentes.

question_en: After repairing a motor starter, what is required?
options: Test the starter assembly for correct operation.
Skip documentation if it runs once.
explanation_en: The starter assembly is to be tested after repair and against manufacturer/facility requirements.
explanation_es: El conjunto del starter debe probarse después de la reparación según requisitos del fabricante y la instalación.

question_en: Which is listed as a motor starter type in the RSOS?
explanation_en: Forward/reverse starters are included in the RSOS range of variables.
explanation_es: Los starters forward/reverse están incluidos en el rango del RSOS.

question_en: Why are conductors and corresponding terminals labelled after starter maintenance?
explanation_en: The RSOS requires conductor/terminal labelling according to drawings and specifications.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige etiquetado de conductores/terminales de acuerdo con planos y especificaciones.

question_en: Maintenance test results differ from specifications. What should guide the maintenance decision?
options: Analysis of test results and comparison with specifications.
Only the age of the starter.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires comparison and analysis of maintenance test results against specifications.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige comparar y analizar los resultados contra especificaciones.

question_en: Which starter is included in the RSOS motor-starter range?
explanation_en: Reduced-voltage starters are included in the official range of variables.
explanation_es: Los starters de voltaje reducido aparecen en el rango oficial del RSOS.

question_en: An AC drive is repaired and operating conditions changed. What may need adjustment before final testing?
explanation_en: D-23.02 states programming is adjusted according to the repair and changes in operating conditions.
explanation_es: D-23.02 indica que la programación se ajusta según la reparación y cambios de condiciones de operación.

question_en: Which parameter is listed for AC-drive maintenance analysis?
explanation_en: Acceleration/deceleration rate is one of the drive parameters listed by the RSOS.
explanation_es: La tasa de aceleración/deceleración es uno de los parámetros listados por el RSOS.

question_en: Which component is explicitly listed as part of an AC drive?
explanation_en: Rectifiers are listed among AC drive components.
explanation_es: Los rectificadores están listados entre los componentes del drive CA.

question_en: After AC-drive repair, what must the assembly do?
options: Function according to manufacturer specifications and facility requirements.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires post-repair testing and correct function to manufacturer/facility requirements.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige prueba posterior y funcionamiento conforme a especificaciones del fabricante y requisitos de la instalación.

question_en: Which action best supports condition-based AC-drive maintenance?
options: Replace every drive on a fixed date regardless of condition.
explanation_en: D-23.02 explicitly calls for comparison and analysis of drive parameters.
explanation_es: D-23.02 exige comparar y analizar los parámetros del drive.

question_en: A 10 hp electrical load is converted to watts using the official exam formula. What is the result?
explanation_es: Usa P = hp × 746 W: 7,460 W.

question_en: A resistive load draws 8 A through 12 Ω. What power is dissipated?
explanation_en: Use P = I²R = 8² × 12 = 768 W.
explanation_es: Usa P = I²R = 8² × 12 = 768 W.

question_en: A 240 V resistive load has 24 Ω resistance. What current flows?
A three-phase motor has been repaired. What should happen before it is returned to normal operation?
options: Conduct post-repair tests and compare results with specifications.
Skip testing if bearings were replaced.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires testing after repair and analysis of maintenance test results.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige pruebas después de la reparación y análisis de resultados.

question_en: Which is a three-phase motor type listed in the RSOS?
explanation_en: Squirrel-cage induction is explicitly listed for three-phase motors.
explanation_es: El motor de inducción jaula de ardilla está listado explícitamente.

question_en: Which item is listed as three-phase motor nameplate data?
explanation_en: Duty cycle is included in the official motor nameplate data range.
explanation_es: El ciclo de trabajo está incluido en los datos de placa oficiales.

question_en: How should replacement three-phase motor components be selected?
explanation_en: D-25.04 requires OEM or equivalent replacement components.
explanation_es: D-25.04 exige componentes OEM o equivalentes.

question_en: Maintenance test results show a change from baseline. What is the correct next approach?
options: Analyze the results and compare them with specifications.
Ignore the change if the motor still turns.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires comparison and analysis of maintenance test results.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige comparación y análisis de resultados de mantenimiento.
